name: Little Haven
subtitle: A town dream and a roadside Airb&b

apps.name: Little Haven
apps.subtitle: Run your Airb&b and car wash.
apps.localizedDescription: Run your Airb&b with animated guest emergencies, changing outdoor weather, and a paid car wash. Watch guests struggle in the pool, angry guests fight, and courtyard fires burn. Hire Diego to scrub and rinse parked guest cars for income. Clean rooms, serve breakfast, wash towels, water plants, repair equipment and carry luggage with visible tools and effects. Guest belongings have recognizable suitcase, watch and camera designs and animate into your hands when stolen. Existing family reception, staff, police events, room upgrades and saved games are supported.

versions.localizedDescription: Animated drowning, angry fights and fire; guest parking and a paid car wash attendant; animated cleaning, outdoor services, theft and changing weather.
More trees, flower beds and benches; daily breakfast, laundry, repairs, gardening and luggage services; varied guests and animated fighting and action feedback.

Airb&b chaos: neglected emergencies can kill guests and summon police. Pay fines or risk a refused bribe. Safety incidents reduce bookings and ratings. Prominent employee hiring, faster emergency cycles and distinct room colors inside and outside.

Motel mayhem: good and bad guest reviews, hired housekeepers, groundskeepers and security, room upgrades, courtyard fires, pool rescues and outdoor fights. Character conversations now use illustrated dialogue boxes inside the game.

Family reception: an expanded office, a fixed desk position, arriving clients with accept/decline conversations, Chichu and Chichi, Samhil watching TV and Hildarelys walking around. Photo-inspired original cut-paper characters. Explore the grounds and interiors with a movement stick, meet clients and collect payments in person, carry cleaning tools, make beds, collect trash, mop spills, customize physical rooms and expand the property. Existing motel saves are supported.

Native RPG engine update: restored cut-paper cartoon characters, SpriteKit map scenes, independent actor sprites and a following camera. Explore the grounds and interiors with a movement stick, meet clients and collect payments in person, carry cleaning tools, make beds, collect trash, mop spills, customize physical rooms and expand the property. Existing motel saves are supported.

The motel chapter: wake up after the town prologue, manage three rooms, welcome guests, customize rooms and office, expand to nine rooms, and risk sneaking into occupied rooms. Getting caught restores your last checkpoint.
New cut-paper cartoon characters and matching portraits. Hold an arrow to walk smoothly; release to stop.
